review.scope: Terms emitted by the ELS OKF semantic and Explorer projections, plus Explorer UI terms used to explain those projections.

terms.application: The generated semantic catalogue is typed as a DCAT catalogue.
terms.definition: A curated collection of metadata about resources.
terms.label: Catalog

terms.application: The ELS API service is a collection of operations accessible through an HTTP interface.
terms.definition: A collection of operations accessible through an interface that provides access to data or processing functions.
terms.label: Data service

terms.application: Links the catalogue to the ELS data-service resource.
terms.definition: Relates a catalogue to a data service that is part of it.
terms.label: service

terms.application: Identifies the documented primary root location of the ELS API service without claiming that it was live-tested.
terms.definition: The root location or primary endpoint of a service.
terms.label: endpoint URL

terms.application: Links the data service to the pinned wiki that describes endpoints and operations.
terms.definition: A resource describing services available through an endpoint, including operations and parameters.
terms.label: endpoint description

terms.application: States the specification followed by the generated OKF catalogue.
terms.definition: An established standard to which the described resource conforms.
terms.label: conforms to

terms.application: Supplies human-readable descriptions for the catalogue, service and operation concepts.
terms.definition: An account of the described resource.
terms.label: description

terms.application: Relates the generated catalogue to the pinned wiki documents included as source-document metadata.
terms.definition: A related resource included physically or logically in the described resource.
terms.label: has part

terms.application: Carries the SHA-256 identifier of a pinned wiki page.
terms.definition: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.
terms.label: identifier

terms.application: Records the publication checkpoint of the generated catalogue, not a source modification date.
terms.definition: The date of formal issuance of the resource.
terms.label: issued

terms.application: Links the generated bundle to its own repository licence; upstream licence evidence is recorded separately.
terms.definition: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.
terms.label: license

terms.application: Identifies the organisation responsible for the described ELS service.
terms.definition: An entity responsible for making the resource available.
terms.label: publisher

terms.application: Links an operation or document projection to the pinned source from which its metadata was obtained.
terms.definition: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.
terms.label: source

terms.application: Supplies human-readable titles for generated semantic resources.
terms.definition: A name given to the resource.
terms.label: title

terms.application: Types the organisation responsible for the upstream ELS service.
terms.definition: An agent such as a person, group or organisation.
terms.label: Agent

terms.application: Types a pinned wiki page as a document rather than as a DCAT catalogue record.
terms.definition: A document.
terms.label: Document

terms.application: Provides the name of an upstream organisation represented as a FOAF agent.
terms.definition: A name for an entity.
terms.label: name

terms.application: Types the non-executing representation of an HTTP operation.
terms.definition: An operation supported by a web API.
terms.label: Operation

terms.application: Types the documented URI template associated with an operation through the producer-defined okf:requestTemplate property.
terms.definition: A template that can be expanded into an IRI using variable mappings.
terms.label: IRI template

terms.application: Types one variable declaration inside an operation URI template.
terms.definition: A mapping from an IRI-template variable to its documented meaning and requirements.
terms.label: IRI template mapping

terms.application: Records the documented GET method of each bounded operation.
terms.definition: The HTTP method of an operation.
terms.label: method

terms.application: Records the non-executing URL template for an ELS operation.
terms.definition: A string representation of an IRI template.
terms.label: template

terms.application: Associates an IRI template with its path and query variable mappings.
terms.definition: A variable mapping contained by an IRI template.
terms.label: mapping

terms.application: Records the name of a documented path or query variable.
terms.definition: The variable represented by an IRI-template mapping.
terms.label: variable

terms.application: Records whether a documented path or query variable is required.
terms.definition: Whether the described value is required.
terms.label: required

terms.application: Records that the generated catalogue was derived from the pinned wiki and bounded application-source review.
terms.definition: Relates a derived entity to an entity from which it was derived.
terms.label: was derived from

terms.application: Classifies an ELS operation as the closest OpenAPI object without claiming that an upstream OpenAPI contract exists.
terms.definition: The OpenAPI object that describes one API operation on a path.
terms.label: OpenAPI Operation Object

terms.application: Carries the bounded standards-alignment claim and its explicit limitations.
terms.definition: Producer-defined statement describing standards mappings without asserting full conformance.
terms.label: alignment claim

terms.application: Relates an API service to a bounded operation description in the Explorer relationship projection.
terms.definition: Producer-defined relation from an API service to one of its documented operations.
terms.label: has operation

terms.application: Relates a service or operation to a preserved review finding.
terms.definition: Producer-defined relation from a reviewed concept to a finding about its documentation, governance or usage boundary.
terms.label: has finding

terms.application: Records the reviewed application-source commit date separately from bundle generation.
terms.definition: Producer-defined date of the pinned application source used by the review.
terms.label: application source modified

terms.application: Records whether a parameter claim came from the wiki, source or both.
terms.definition: Producer-defined evidence classification for a projected assertion.
terms.label: evidence

terms.application: States that the bundle does not include API execution.
terms.definition: Producer-defined boolean indicating whether executable behavior is included.
terms.label: execution included

terms.application: Records the generation checkpoint of a projection.
terms.definition: Producer-defined generation datetime for the projected artifact.
terms.label: generated at

terms.application: States that current live deployment status was not checked.
terms.definition: Producer-defined declaration of the live-verification boundary.
terms.label: live status

terms.application: States that an operation was not verified against a live deployment.
terms.definition: Producer-defined boolean indicating whether the described resource was checked live.
terms.label: live verified

terms.application: Links an operation to its non-executing Hydra IRI-template projection without using hydra:expects incorrectly.
terms.definition: Producer-defined relation from an API operation to its documented request IRI template.
terms.label: request template

terms.application: Links the semantic catalogue to its normative OKF Markdown root.
terms.definition: Producer-defined link to the normative Markdown entrypoint.
terms.label: normative entrypoint

terms.application: States that observation values are excluded from the bundle.
terms.definition: Producer-defined boolean indicating whether observation values are included.
terms.label: observations included

terms.application: Records the declared OKF core version.
terms.definition: Producer-defined OKF version identifier.
terms.label: OKF version

terms.application: Links the data-service instance to its bounded operation descriptions without asserting Hydra class semantics.
terms.definition: Producer-defined relation from a service instance to a documented operation.
terms.label: supported operation

terms.application: Records that the evidence set is a frozen snapshot.
terms.definition: Producer-defined snapshot-mode declaration.
terms.label: snapshot mode

terms.application: Carries the internal/private/unstable source-state label without treating it as OKF lifecycle status.
terms.definition: Producer-defined source-state declaration.
terms.label: source status

terms.application: Records the associated application-repository licence as source evidence without claiming it licenses the wiki.
terms.definition: Producer-defined link to licence evidence associated with an upstream source.
terms.label: source licence evidence

terms.application: Records the pinned wiki commit date separately from bundle generation.
terms.definition: Producer-defined date of the pinned wiki source used by the review.
terms.label: wiki source modified

uiTerms.definition: Evidence resources linked to a record, such as an endpoint template, documentation, contract or source metadata row.
uiTerms.label: Evidence resources

uiTerms.definition: A deterministic score about metadata completeness only; it is not assurance, certification, uptime, security or service quality.
uiTerms.label: Metadata quality

uiTerms.definition: The normalized concept kind used for filtering and presentation.
uiTerms.label: Record type

uiTerms.definition: The adapter or evidence process from which the projection was produced.
uiTerms.label: Source

uiTerms.definition: Strength of the evidence supporting a projected record; this is distinct from OKF verification trust.
uiTerms.label: Evidence confidence

uiTerms.definition: The licence attached to the bundle or record, kept separate from associated-source licence evidence.
uiTerms.label: Licence

uiTerms.definition: How a licence statement was obtained, such as bundle-declared, source-declared, inherited or associated-repository evidence.
uiTerms.label: Licence basis

uiTerms.definition: The documented authentication or approval requirement. Internal/private visibility does not by itself identify an access mechanism.
uiTerms.label: Access model

uiTerms.definition: Whether a machine-readable contract was found and whether it is upstream, generated or incomplete.
uiTerms.label: Contract status

uiTerms.definition: The closest applicable DCAT class or property role. Absence is preferable to applying an unrelated DCAT term.
uiTerms.label: DCAT term

uiTerms.definition: The closest OpenAPI object or fragment; this is an export hint rather than proof of a complete OpenAPI description.
uiTerms.label: OpenAPI term

uiTerms.definition: The applicable Hydra class or property used in the semantic API description.
uiTerms.label: Hydra term

uiTerms.definition: Whether required fields are available for a standards projection and which fields remain missing.
uiTerms.label: Standards export readiness

uiTerms.definition: The date on which the source evidence was observed or pinned; it is not the bundle generation time.
uiTerms.label: Source evidence observed

uiTerms.definition: A generated assessment of how useful a field is for navigation; it does not measure the quality of the underlying service.
uiTerms.label: Facet navigation signal
